row: Here at PMC Physiotherapy, we pride ourselves on getting results for our patients. A large part of the rehabilitation process is the selection of the correct exercise protocols for recovery but also the correct execution of these exercises. with most exercises there is one way to do it right and about 20 ways to do it wrong, but make it look like you're doing it right. Using this channel I aim to help patients execute correctly some of the commonly used exercises in Sports and Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation. Technique is everything.
